title: daapu configuration
description: Configuration of the daapu harness, loaded from config.jsonc. Mirrors the Kotlin models in info.skyblond.daapu.config (see AGENTS.md: keep this schema in sync with the config models).

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema file.

url.description: JDBC URL for PostgreSQL, e.g. jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/postgres

providers.description: OpenAI-compatible LLM providers, keyed by provider id. The id prefixes every model id ({provider.id}/{modelId}), so only [0-9a-z_-] is allowed. May be empty.

port.description: HTTP API port; the frontend dev server proxies /api to it.

servers.description: MCP tool servers; all their tools are advertised to every chat run.

memory.description: The memory pipeline settings: compaction (agent/oneshot/compaction/) and the ELTM (external long-term memory, memory/eltm/). The model ids are REQUIRED, resolved once at startup by the DI container (di/DaapuModule.kt) and reused for every run (never the run's model). The compaction trigger fraction and keep rounds are per-model (agent/model/LLM.kt), depending on the model's context size.

compactModel.description: Required catalog model id for the compaction summarizer.

eltm.description: The ELTM (diary model) settings: REQUIRED for every deployment — the extraction pipeline and the investigate agent's ELTM access depend on it. The extraction, embedding, writer, and rewrite model ids are resolved once at startup by the DI container (di/DaapuModule.kt; unknown ids and a writer without tool-call support fail fast). The embedding model's output dimensions must not exceed 2000 (pgvector's HNSW limit): the ELTM vector columns are fixed at 2000 and shorter vectors are zero-padded on write, so switching embedding models never needs a schema change.

extractionModel.description: Required catalog model id for the memory extractor (sees the raw dropped history, images included; no tool calls).

embeddingModel.description: Required catalog id of the embedding model; its entry carries the output dimensions.

writerModel.description: Required catalog LLM id of the ELTM writer (a tool loop; must support tool calls).

rewriteModel.description: Required catalog LLM id of the query rewrite one-shot (a no-tools /v1/run): rewrites the run's latest input into standalone retrieval queries before the chat round.

rewriteRounds.description: REQUIRED: how many trailing user rounds of the chat feed the query rewrite one-shot (the limit is related to the rewrite model's context size).

relatedEntitiesLimit.description: REQUIRED: how many related entities the ELTM context injection puts into <memories>' <related-entities> (injection size is related to the main model's context); 0 skips the entity search.

relatedNotesLimit.description: REQUIRED: how many related diary notes the ELTM context injection puts into <memories>' <related-notes> (injection size is related to the main model's context); 0 skips the note search (with both limits 0 the query rewrite one-shot is skipped too).

entityMatchThreshold.description: Cosine floor for the create_entity near-match candidates (0..1).

maxWriterRounds.description: Round cap for the ELTM writer tool loop; 0 = unlimited.

agent.description: The sub-agent settings: the investigate agent (agent/oneshot/investigate/InvestigatorService.kt), a tool loop that gathers information from the ELTM (read-only) and the web (MCP tools) on behalf of the main agent.

investigator.description: The investigate sub-agent: the model id is REQUIRED and resolved once at startup by the DI container (di/DaapuModule.kt; unknown ids and a model without tool-call support fail fast). allowedNamespaces is the sub-agent's tool whitelist over its OWN tool set (the read-only eltm tools plus the MCP servers, built separately from the chat loop's set): REQUIRED, non-empty, and every entry must be a namespace that set serves (a typo — or an attempt to whitelist gsg itself, which would enable recursion — fails fast at boot via the WhitelistedToolProvider construction).

model.description: Required catalog LLM id of the investigate sub-agent (a tool loop; must support tool calls).

maxRounds.description: Round cap for the investigate tool loop; 0 = unlimited.

allowedNamespaces.description: The namespaces the investigate sub-agent may execute (a whitelist over its own tool set — the read-only eltm tools plus the MCP servers); required, non-empty, entries validated like any tool namespace (only [0-9a-z_-], no '__').

title.description: Session-title generation settings (agent/oneshot/TitleGenerator.kt): the model id is REQUIRED, resolved once at startup by the DI container (di/DaapuModule.kt) like the memory pipeline models (never the run's model).

model.description: Required catalog model id for the session-title generator.

lastNRound.description: How many trailing user rounds of the history feed the title generator; 0 (default) means the whole history.

hand.description: The hand-pi execution service (hand-pi/): a stateless Node service that owns LLM execution. The token is shared with the hand's tool callbacks into this process. The run-policy knobs are sent with every /v1/run request (the hand holds no defaults).

token.description: The shared static token (HAND_TOKEN on the hand's side).

streamIdleTimeoutMs.description: Stream idle timeout per round in ms; 0 = disabled.

apiKey.description: API key of the OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the provider, used as-is by the hand-pi service; must carry the full /v1 root (e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1).

namespace.description: Prefix of the advertised tool names ({namespace}__{tool}): only [0-9a-z_-], no '__', and not a harness-reserved namespace.

type.description: http: Streamable HTTP server (url + optional headers); stdio: local subprocess (command + optional environment).

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint; required when type is http.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers, e.g. Authorization for type http.

command.description: Subprocess argv; required when type is stdio.

environment.description: Extra environment variables merged onto the inherited environment of the stdio subprocess.

initializationTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout of the MCP initialize handshake.

toolExecutionTimeoutSeconds.description: Execution budget of one tool call in seconds, REQUIRED per server (0 = no timeout). Enforced by the brain on the tool callback via withTimeout (overrun answers an isError result); the hand applies no deadline of its own and waits until the brain answers or the connection drops.

reconnectAttempts.description: Total connect attempts including the first one (1 means no retry).

reconnectDelayMs.description: Delay between connect attempts in milliseconds.
